name: Zhongtong Bus Holding Co.,LTD
summary: Zhongtong Bus Holding Co.,LTD engages in the manufacture and sale of buses in China. It offers tourists buses, public buses, highway passenger bus, corporate shuttle buses, school bus, logistics, vehicle, RV, and special vehicles and provides marketing services. Zhongtong Bus Holding Co.,LTD was formerly known as Zhongtong Bus Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Zhongtong Bus Holding Co.,LTD in June 2021. The company was founded in 1958 and is based in Liaocheng, China.
